ruleDefinitions.name: Shell Execution via Find - Linux
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of the find command to execute a shell. Such behavior may be associated with privilege escalation, unauthorized command execution, or exploitation attempt.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\/find$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\\.\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-exec.*"))) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/bin\\/bash.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/bin\\/dash.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/bin\\/fish.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/bin\\/sh.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/bin\\/zsh.*")))
